## Description

Performs a comprehensive review of the current project: machine validator baseline first, then parallel specialist agents (scope-triageable: full / scoped / baseline-only). Use when: user requests a full project review ("/project-review" or "do a full project review"); PM detects structural changes (3+ agent files modified, phase schema changes, workspace-schema.json modified, new variant added); QA escalation from auditor (audit.ts ERROR >= 3 or security Critical finding).
